summary: Body scans (InBody) on Progress > Weight: a new bodyScans store (DB 10) records the 8 main numbers per scan with change vs the previous scan, a history sheet and a line on Overview; the scan's clothed weight is shown against that morning's weigh-in and never feeds weigh-ins.
why: The owner wants a weekly body-composition record beside the daily weigh-ins, and the clothed scan weight should not skew them.
